metadata.description: Local marketplace for CLI parsing, terminal dispatching, and command architecture plugins bundled with LtiRomGui.

plugins.name: clikt
plugins.description: Build modern, multiplatform, intuitive command-line interfaces and terminal dispatchers in Kotlin using Clikt 5. Provides patterns for commands, subcommands, coroutine-based suspending commands, options, arguments, validation, autocompletion, context chaining, and unit testing.
